items.prompt: Which statement about a page fault is accurate?

options.text: Some faults are handled normally rather than terminating
options.why: Demand allocation/nonresident/COW cases can be recoverable.

options.text: Every TLB miss means disk swap and a crash
options.why: Translation miss and fault/disk behavior differ.

options.text: A mapping makes every access permitted regardless of flags
A successful page translation validates every C++ alias

items.explanation: The OS/platform and access condition decide handling; do not equate every fault with a fatal error.
